bugs.error_message: All 16 MOST parameters in DB are metadata junk — no real product parameters stored from Most XML
bugs.root_cause: Two bugs: (1) extractMostParameters() iterated top-level product Map fields (code, partnum, main_picture_url etc.) instead of the nested 'properties' Map which contains actual XML product specs. (2) generateMostKey() regex [^a-z0-9\s]+ stripped all Cyrillic characters, turning Bulgarian parameter names like 'Размери (мм)' into empty strings, falling back to 'unknown_param'.
bugs.fix: Fixed extractMostParameters() to read from mostProduct.get('properties') (Map<String,String> from XML <properties> element). Fixed generateMostKey() regex to [^a-z0-9а-яё\s]+ to preserve Cyrillic. SQL: DELETE FROM parameters WHERE platform = 'MOST' to clean up all 16 junk entries.

bugs.error_message: Скрити категории (show_flag=false) се появяват в навигационното меню на фронтенда
bugs.root_cause: getAllCategories() (non-paginated, използван от GET /api/categories) викаше findAll() вместо findByShowTrue() — връщаше всички категории включително скритите Asbis roots.
bugs.fix: Сменен findAll() с findByShowTrue() в non-paginated getAllCategories(). Добавен List<Category> findByShowTrue() в CategoryRepository.

bugs.error_message: InvalidDataAccessApiUsageException: Modifying queries can only use void or int/Integer as return type
bugs.root_cause: hideAsbisProductsNotIn() declared return type long — Spring Data @Modifying queries only support void/int/Integer.
bugs.fix: Changed return type from long to int in both repository interface and service call site.

bugs.error_message: HibernateException: A collection with orphan deletion was no longer referenced by the owning entity instance: Product.productParameters
bugs.root_cause: setAsbisParametersToProduct() built a new HashSet 'merged' and called product.setProductParameters(merged), replacing the Hibernate-managed collection. With orphanRemoval=true Hibernate tracks the exact collection instance — replacing it at flush causes this exception.
bugs.fix: Replaced product.setProductParameters(merged) with existingParams.clear() + existingParams.addAll(manualParams) + existingParams.addAll(autoParams). Mutates the existing managed collection in-place instead of swapping it.

bugs.error_message: Found 0 Product nodes in PriceAvail XML — syncAsbisPriceAvail() updates nothing
bugs.root_cause: parsePriceAvailFromXML() searched for getElementsByTagName('Product') but the real Asbis PriceAvail.xml uses <PRICE> tags inside <PRICES>. Field names also wrong: WIC (not ProductCode), MY_PRICE (not Price), AVAIL text 'да'/'По заявка' (not Stock integer), CURRENCY_CODE (not Currency).
bugs.fix: Changed getElementsByTagName('Product') → 'PRICE'. Rewrote extractPriceAvailFromElement() to read WIC, MY_PRICE, RETAIL_PRICE, AVAIL, CURRENCY_CODE, WARRANTYTERM. AVAIL 'да' maps to stock=1, anything else maps to stock=0.

bugs.error_message: SQL Error [42703]: column cp.option_count does not exist
bugs.root_cause: category_parameters table has only (category_id, parameter_id, is_filter). There is no option_count column — the count must be computed with a subquery against parameter_options.
bugs.fix: Replaced cp.option_count with (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parameter_options po WHERE po.parameter_id = p.id) in both the UPDATE WHERE clause and the verification SELECT.

bugs.error_message: Tekra camera subcategories (IP Камери, Аналогови камери, NVR/DVR Рекордери) show no filters — only brands
bugs.root_cause: syncTekraParameters() only processes categories with tekraSlug set. The discriminated subcategories (IP Камери, Аналогови камери, etc.) are created manually via ensureAnalogDigitalSubcategories() without a tekraSlug, so they are never included in the parameter→category join. Products get remapped to these subcategories in syncTekraProducts() via findCategoryWithTypeDiscrimination(), but category_parameters is never populated for them.
bugs.fix: Added a native bulk INSERT at the end of syncTekraProducts() that populates missing category_parameters from product_parameters for all TEKRA products. Uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING so it is idempotent.

bugs.error_message: Asbis products with zero price appear in the storefront
bugs.root_cause: Two bugs: (1) setAsbisProductFields() set show=true/status=AVAILABLE for new products before PriceAvail sync ran — they were visible with no price. (2) syncAsbisPriceAvail() set show based only on inStock (stock>0), ignoring price — products with AVAIL='да' but MY_PRICE=0 became visible.
bugs.fix: (1) New products now start with show=false/status=NOT_AVAILABLE. (2) visible = inStock && hasPrice (price > 0). Both conditions must be true for a product to be shown.

bugs.error_message: Търсачката връща 0 резултата или хвърля NullPointerException при POST /api/products/search

bugs.error_message: Всички Asbis продукти остават show_flag=false след syncAsbisPriceAvail() — AVAIL='да' никога не се разпознава

bugs.fix: Смяна на getForObject(url, String.class) → getForObject(url, byte[].class) и new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8) в getRawProductListXML() и getRawPriceAvailXML(). Добавен import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.

bugs.error_message: Selecting a Socket filter hid all options from other filter groups (RAM, Cores, etc.)
bugs.root_cause: getFilteredFacets used a single SQL query with all active filters in the WHERE clause. This caused the result to contain only products matching ALL filters, so other parameters' options that had no products matching the active filter were absent. Frontend Filter.jsx then hid groups with 0 options.
bugs.fix: Replaced single-query approach with disjunctive (independent) faceting: Step 1 loads all filterable parameters for the category. Step 2 runs a separate SQL query per parameter, applying all active filters EXCEPT that parameter's own filter. This ensures each parameter group always shows its full option set given the other active filters.

bugs.root_cause: ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN взима ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock — най-силният, блокира дори четене. Скриптът беше пуснат от GUI клиент в manual-commit режим, който остави транзакцията отворена (pg_stat_activity: 'idle in transaction', wait_event ClientRead, 6 минути). pg_blocking_pids показа един блокиращ PID 1465782 и 22 блокирани Hibernate заявки. При пул от 20 връзки това изчерпа connection pool-а и сайтът спря да отговаря. Утежняващо: чакащ ACCESS EXCLUSIVE в lock опашката блокира и всички ПОСЛЕДВАЩИ четения зад себе си, дори да са съвместими помежду си.
bugs.fix: Три промени в скрипта: (1) ALTER TABLE е в собствен явен BEGIN/COMMIT, за да се освободи локът независимо от auto-commit настройката на клиента; (2) SET lock_timeout = '10s' — ALTER-ът се отказва бързо вместо да застане на опашка пред четящите; (3) SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '60s' — сървърът сам прекъсва забравена отворена транзакция. Разрешено чрез ROLLBACK от потребителя; базата остана чиста (колоната не беше създадена).
